tracks.title: Leave the Radio On
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro: four bars]
[Verse 1]
The radio had a silver dial
It kept us warm for one more mile

tracks.title: The Blue Cup by the Window
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The blue cup by the window
Caught the early light

tracks.title: First Snow Avenue
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
Snow was falling on the avenue

tracks.title: Sunday Train
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
We took the quiet Sunday train

tracks.title: The Last Cafe
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
The last cafe was closing down

tracks.title: Old Polaroid
tracks.lyrics:
[Chorus]
Your smile lives in an old Polaroid

tracks.title: Slow Dance Kitchen
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
We slow danced in the kitchen

tracks.title: Paper Moon
tracks.lyrics:
[Tag]
A paper moon above the town

tracks.title: Morning News
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
Morning news was on the table

tracks.title: Velvet December
tracks.lyrics:
[Final Chorus]
Velvet December called my name

tracks.title: Corner Record Shop
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
At the corner record shop we met

tracks.title: Keep the Porch Light
tracks.lyrics:
[Outro]
Keep the porch light on tonight
